def policy(pieces, to_play, legal_moves, memory):
    def get_move_value(move):
        # Determine the value of the piece moving (for captures)
        if move[0] in ['N', 'B', 'R', 'Q', 'K']:
            piece_type = move[0]
        elif move[0].islower() or move[0] == 'x':  # pawn or other capture
            piece_type = 'P'
        else:
            piece_type = 'P'  # default, unlikely
        values = {'P':1, 'N':3, 'B':3, 'R':5, 'Q':9, 'K':0}
        return values.get(piece_type, 1)  # default 1 for pawns
    
    def get_destination_square(move):
        if move in ['O-O', 'O-O-O']:
            return None
        if 'x' in move:
            after_x = move.split('x')[-1]
            # the destination is the first two characters after x that form a square
            square = ''
            for ch in after_x:
                if ch.isalpha() or ch.isdigit():
                    square += ch
                if len(square) == 2:
                    break
            return square
        elif '=' in move:
            # promote
            parts = move.split('=')
            return parts[0][-2:]
        elif 'O' in move:
            return None
        else:
            return move[-2:]
    
    best_move = ''
    max_score = -float('inf')
    
    current_color = 'w' if to_play == 'white' else 'b'
    
    for move in legal_moves:
        score = 0
        
        # Checkmate moves
        if move.endswith('#'):
            score += 1000
        elif move.endswith('+'):
            score += 50
        
        # Promotion moves
        if '=' in move and not move.endswith('+') and not move.endswith('#'):
            score += 30  # promoting is generally good
        
        # Capture moves

            dest_square = get_destination_square(move)
            if dest_square in pieces:

                    score += (captured_val - capturer_val)
        
        # Castling
        if move == 'O-O' or move == 'O-O-O':
            score += 20
        
        # If this is the best so far
        if score > max_score:
            max_score = score
            best_move = move
    
    return (best_move, memory)
